title: Arrowsmith, Map of the Island of Ceylon (1805)
method: Affine fit to 9 control points (scripts/maps/arrow_pts.json); RMS 6.5 km. The printed longitudes are offset from true values, as usual before chronometer surveys.

title: VOC chart: Pascaert van 't Eylandt Ceylon (c. 1700; Commons dates the file 1753)
method: Drawn east-up; rotated, then affine fit to 9 control points (scripts/maps/dutch_pts.json); RMS 13.7 km, reflecting the chart's own distortion of the island's shape.
